codeReview.summary: Complete and correct implementation of DELETE /api/v1/evaluations/:id endpoint. All 6 expected behaviors verified: cancel pending/running returns 200 with status=cancelled, completed returns 409, already cancelled is idempotent (200), not found returns 404, invalid UUID returns 400. Repository properly updates status and timestamps in DB.

summary: Feature api-cancel-endpoint passes review. Implementation correctly handles all cancel scenarios (pending/running→200, completed→409, already cancelled→idempotent 200, not found→404, invalid UUID→400). 6 comprehensive unit tests cover all scenarios. Code quality verified with build, vet, and fmt.
